name: binaural_theta_6hz
note: Binaural beat at 6 Hz (theta range) on a 200 Hz carrier, under a soft brown-noise bed. Needs stereo headphones: the two ears hear different tones and the beat forms in the listener's head. No health claim is made. Vary: minutes, layers[0].carrier_hz (150 to 300), layers[0].beat_hz, the tone's gain_db against the bed.
